Designing for a coastal city

Vizag's sea breeze is lovely, but salt air and humidity are hard on interiors. We choose moisture-resistant boards, corrosion-resistant hardware and finishes that won't peel or swell, and we plan ventilation so homes stay fresh through the monsoon.

Many Vizag homes have sea or hill views. We plan layouts, windows and balconies to make the most of them while keeping afternoon heat and glare under control.
